stories.title: Holiday hunger bill to face final Stormont hurdle
stories.summary: The new law would would help poorer families with food costs during school holidays.

stories.title: Headteachers say families will struggle after another rise in school dinner prices
stories.summary: The price of a school dinner in a primary school will have risen from £2.60 to £3.40 since the start of 2026.

stories.title: Disruption warning amid huge security operation in Dublin for EU meetings
stories.summary: Irish police say it is going to be the largest security operation in the history of the state.

stories.title: To the day I die, I will regret putting a cigarette in my mouth
stories.summary: Joan McConville is calling for a national screening programme in Northern Ireland, like there is in England and Wales.

stories.title: Brother and sister beaten in 'sickening' racist gang attack
stories.summary: A woman says her siblings were subjected to racial abuse before being assaulted by a group of men.

stories.title: DUP seeks to block law on Irish-medium schools
stories.summary: The private member's bill would require Stormont's Department of Education to prepare a workforce plan on Irish-medium schools.

stories.title: Workers rights reforms will not happen before next election
stories.summary: The DUP opposed elements of the draft bill and refused to allow it to be debated by the Assembly.

stories.title: Chloe Mitchell murder trial hears how police discovered remains
stories.summary: A householder's apology over a smell from her bin led officers to find the remains of the 21 year-old.

stories.title: Residents appeal over street light removal
stories.summary: Almost a hundred families will be affected by the loss of the streetlights.

stories.title: Omagh inquiry told gardaí warned RUC of car bomb crossing border
stories.summary: The explosion killed 29 people, including a woman pregnant with twins.

stories.title: Body found during search for missing woman
stories.summary: The PSNI have been given extra time to question two people arrested on suspicion of murder.

stories.title: Birds return to waterfowl park after oil vandalism
stories.summary: The vandalism of a nearby home heating oil tank resulted in the death of 13 birds from the park.
